filename: ClimSim_ A large multi-scale dataset for hybrid physics-ML climate emulation.pdf
title: ClimSim: A large multi-scale dataset for hybrid physics-ML climate emulation
venue: 37th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2023) Track on Datasets and Benchmarks
parameterization_target: Sub-grid atmospheric convection, cloud microphysics, turbulence, and radiative heating/fluxes (multi-scale superparameterization tendency and surface flux emulation)
testbed_rationale: ClimSim is an explicitly designed, publicly accessible community benchmark dataset for machine learning parameterization and sub-grid physics emulation in Earth system models (E3SM-MMF), offering high- and low-resolution data with standard splits, full coupling variables, and baseline code.
pain_points: No downstream online coupling testbed/workflow yet integrated into the repository
Scale separation assumption inherent in MMF (laterally periodic CRM)
Extreme events / tail behavior of precipitation are challenging to capture (negative R2 for extreme precipitation baselines)
Mass and energy conservation must be explicitly enforced
High data volume for high-resolution dataset (41.2 TB)
extraction_notes: The paper explicitly presents offline regression baselines; online coupling is noted as future work / open challenge.
